app.name: Waze travel time
app.summary: Your travel time from Waze: the fastest route now, the delay, and how traffic went the last hours.
app.opt_usual_hint: Your time without traffic, for the delay and the dashed line. 0 shows no delay.
app.opt_hours_hint: How far back the line under the time goes. 0 shows no line.
app.opt_region_hint: The region of your Waze Travel Time integration, for the routes on the card.
app.in_sensor: Waze sensor for the top bar
app.in_sensor_hint: The Waze Travel Time sensor the top bar's item shows. Tiles choose their own sensor in the inspector.
app.setting_usual: Usual travel time in the top bar
app.setting_usual_hint: Your time without traffic, in minutes: the top bar's car turns green, amber or red by the delay. 0 keeps it grey.
